reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 only mentions nano-precipitation as a general strengthening mechanism in HEAs without reference to the WTaTiVZr system or high-temperature stability. E2 reports a single-phase BCC structure and microhardness increase after annealing at 900 °C for WTaVTiZrx, but provides no evidence of nano-precipitate formation, coherency, or their role in strain hardening and toughness enhancement.
premises: Equimolar WTaTiVZr HEA can form fine, coherent nano-precipitates within a single-phase BCC matrix
These nano-precipitates are stable under high-temperature loading (900–1200 °C)
Nano-precipitates impede dislocation motion and promote multistage strain hardening
This strain hardening delays localization and crack initiation, enhancing ductility and toughness
Pure tungsten lacks such nano-precipitates and exhibits high lattice friction with limited plasticity
